slides.heading: An unpaid invoice
slides.body: The fix: send invoices the day the work is done, with a clear due date and a friendly reminder after seven days.

slides.heading: No savings buffer
slides.body: The fix: move a fixed percentage of every payment to a separate account before you spend anything.

slides.heading: Saying yes to everything
slides.body: The fix: decide what your ideal client looks like, and let the rest go.

slides.heading: Doing it all alone
slides.body: The fix: automate one repetitive task this month. Start small.

slides.title: Happy Halloween
slides.body: Save this and fix one thing this week. 🤍
